mapper.select: /*buyer.mpso.getCowayReturnPeriod*/ SELECT CODE, SUBSTR(TEXT1,1,4) || '/' || SUBSTR(TEXT1,5,2) || '/' || SUBSTR(TEXT1,7,2) AS TEXT1, SUBSTR(TEXT2,1,4) || '/' || SUBSTR(TEXT2,5,2) || '/' || SUBSTR(TEXT2,7,2) AS TEXT2, SUBSTR(TEXT3,1,4) || '/' || SUBSTR(TEXT3,5,2) || '/' || SUBSTR(TEXT3,7,2) AS TEXT3, SUBSTR(TEXT4,1,4) || '/' || SUBSTR(TEXT4,5,2) || '/' || SUBSTR(TEXT4,7,2) AS TEXT4 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C008' AND CODE = #{st_rtn_yyyymm} AND COMPANY_CODE = #{st_buyer}
mapper.update: /* buyer.mpso.setCowayReturnPeriod */ MERGE INTO ICOMCOD2 A USING ( SELECT 'C008' AS TYPE, #{st_rtn_yyyymm} AS CODE, #{st_buyer} AS COMPANY_CODE FROM DUAL ) B ON (1 = 1 AND B.TYPE = A.TYPE AND B.CODE = A.CODE AND B.COMPANY_CODE = A.COMPANY_CODE ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET TEXT1 = REPLACE(#{st_rtn_from_date},'/',''), TEXT2 = REPLACE(#{st_rtn_to_date},'/',''), TEXT3 = REPLACE(#{st_po_from_date},'/',''), TEXT4 = REPLACE(#{st_po_to_date},'/',''), ADD_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TYPE, CODE, COMPANY_CODE, TEXT1, TEXT2, TEXT3, TEXT4, FLAG, ADD_DATE) VALUES ( 'C008', #{st_rtn_yyyymm}, #{st_buyer}, REPLACE(#{st_rtn_from_date},'/',''), REPLACE(#{st_rtn_to_date},'/',''), REPLACE(#{st_po_from_date},'/',''), REPLACE(#{st_po_to_date},'/',''), 'Y', TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') )
